_comment: Original game dialogue written for this prototype. Not manuscript text.
Sources: observed = seen/heard/played here; reported = a character's claim;
recalled = the protagonist's uncertain memory; imagined = expectation only.
A node without 'next' falls through to the next node in file order;

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Oh — you're up. I was starting to think I'd have to poke you.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Last term, though. Last term. How did that happen?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You've got that look again. The one where you don't know what day it is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Ha. Ha ha. Okay.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You did that in the corridor last week. Asked me who I was, then walked into the fire door.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: It's Q. I sit next to you. I've sat next to you for two years.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: What day is it?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Thursday. First Thursday of the last term. Second bell in about four minutes.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Biology first. So. Upright, if you can manage it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You don't answer.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Right. The silent thing. That's fine.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I'll talk for both of us. It's Thursday, by the way. Second bell in about four minutes.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Anyway. The exam.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You left the second page completely empty. Not a wrong answer. Nothing. She held it up like it was evidence.

effects.speaker: q
effects.text: Q says you left the second page of the biology exam blank and that B held it up in front of the class.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Not that I did much better. I wrote my name. Then I wrote it again.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: I don't remember the exam.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You told Q you do not remember the biology exam.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Sure. Two weeks of you carrying that book around, and you don't remember the exam.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You know what's strange? I believe you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It was one page.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: It was two. I counted. I had nothing else to do.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Why do you care?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I don't. I'm being friendly. It's nine in the morning.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Also it's the last term. People get strange in the last term.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: She'll want the book open, by the way. She always wants the book open.

effects.speaker: q
effects.text: Q says the biology teacher expects the textbook open on the desk.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: B. Biology. She comes in at the second bell like the room belongs to her. Which I suppose it does.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Is she strict?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Strict is one word for it.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: There's a wooden set square on her desk. Nobody moves it. Nobody puts a bag near it.

effects.speaker: q
effects.text: Q claims nobody touches the wooden set square on B's desk.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: She's late.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: She's never late. That's the thing about her. She's here, or there's a reason, and nobody tells me the reason.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You'll see. She comes through that door and the room gets smaller.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You look at your desk.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You've gone quiet. Fine. Don't say I didn't tell you.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Check your bag, by the way. You were carrying it around all morning like you were going somewhere.

effects.text: Find your biology textbook. Check your bag.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I'm going to stop talking at you now. That was the plan, anyway.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You've got the face. The lost-something face.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: My textbook's gone.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Gone where? It was in your bag this morning. I saw the corner of it.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Actually. No. Maybe I saw the corner of something else.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Did you take it?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Me. You think I took your biology book.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I can't even find the timetable. Offence noted, by the way. In ink.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (Never mind.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Sure. Never mind. I'll stand here minding nothing.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: When she asks, look at your desk. It works better than talking.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Free period. I knew it. I said it, didn't I.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: That's a substitute, not B.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: A substitute who has already given up. Best kind.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Coming?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: In a minute. I want to see if they actually write anything on the board.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You pick up your bag.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Yeah. Go on. I'll catch up.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Don't go past the gate without me. It's a long walk and I'm not carrying the conversation on my own.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You're not going to look, are you.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Bag. On the floor. Next to your foot. That's the one.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: That's the second bell.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: She's not out there. I'd have heard her.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Don't look at me like that. I'm not the one who's late.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Stand up.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: I said stand.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Everyone else has the book open. You have your hands.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Come here. Bring your bag.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The set square going down on the front desk. Hard. You remember the sound. You are less sure about anything else.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You half-remember the wooden set square being put down hard on the front desk, and you do not trust the memory.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: You will see me about this.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Right. Hello. Um.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Biology. This is biology, isn't it.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I'm covering. For the usual teacher. Nobody told me how much to — I have a sheet.

effects.speaker: n
effects.text: N says they are covering the biology lesson for the usual teacher.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Attendance. I'll read the list and you say if it's you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nobody answers. N writes something down anyway.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Great. Okay. I've put a tick next to most of you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Where's the usual teacher?

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: She's on the sheet. There's a line through her name.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I don't know what a line through it means. I'm going to assume it's fine.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Do we need the textbook?

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: There's supposed to be a cupboard. In the corridor. With spares.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I haven't been down there. Someone could check. Not — not necessarily me.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You wait.)

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Someone usually talks. That's fine. Silence is — allowed.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Look. It's Thursday, it's the last term, and I'm not going to stand here pretending this is a lesson.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Read something. Sit quietly. Or go — go and do whatever it is people do. Free period.

effects.speaker: n
effects.text: N says the class may leave for a free period.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I'll be here. If anyone asks, I was here.
